archetype: Architectural / Tactical Developer IDE (Swiss & Dark-Mode-First High Density)
emotional_tone: Precision, reliability, ultra-fast client-side execution, dense utility, developer-focused transparency

theme_strategy.theme_support: Dark and light with interactive toggle

typography.ui_font: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

layout_architecture.mobile_strategy: Tabbed view on screens below 768px (DDL Editor | Query Console | Results & ERD)

desktop_structure.header: Fixed top bar h-12 flex items-center justify-between px-4 border-b z-50
desktop_structure.left_pane: DDL Schema Editor + Seed Config Generator + Summary Report (Width: 35-40%, resizable)
desktop_structure.right_pane: Split vertically into Upper-Right (Query Console) & Lower-Right (Tabbed Results / ERD / Execution Details)
desktop_structure.upper_right_pane: SQL Console with toolbar (Run, Clear, Examples, History) + CodeMirror (Height: ~45%)
desktop_structure.lower_right_pane: Tabs for Results, Schema/ERD (React Flow), Execution Details (Height: ~55%)

components_specification.Header: Compact bar with App Title ('Local-First SQLite Playground'), Subtitle ('Client-side WASM IDE'), DB status pill, workspace status pill ('Unshared changes' / 'Synced'), action buttons: Share Workspace, Export .sqlite, Reset, Theme Toggle.
components_specification.LeftPane_SchemaEditor: CodeMirror SQL editor for DDL + Seed control panel (Rows: 10/50/100 toggle, Seed input for deterministic seed data, 'Interpret Schema & Generate Seed' button, Reset button) + Summary report card showing created tables, row count, foreign key relations.
components_specification.UpperRightPane_QueryConsole: CodeMirror SQL query editor + Action Toolbar: Run (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter), Clear, Example Queries Dropdown, Query History drawer/modal. Keyboard shortcut tooltips.
components_specification.LowerRightPane_ResultsTab: High-density data grid with sortable columns, pagination controls (10, 25, 50, 100 rows per page), copy to clipboard, CSV export, distinct visualization badges for NULL (amber/gold tag) and BLOB (purple binary hex badge), truncation notice when results > limit, timing & row metrics footer.
components_specification.LowerRightPane_ERDTab: Interactive React Flow diagram mapping schema tables as nodes with primary key (PK) / foreign key (FK) badges, column data types, connecting directional edges, pan/zoom controls, and color-coded legend.
components_specification.LowerRightPane_ExecutionDetailsTab: Structured query analysis tab showing parsing time, execution time, total latency, affected rows, query AST/structure summary, and detailed formatted error callouts if execution fails.

data_testid_guidelines.mandatory: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, selects, editor regions) must contain explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 100% client-side functionality using sql.js Web Worker or in-browser WASM execution.
Support dark and light mode seamlessly using CSS root variables and Tailwind dark: classes.
Maintain high density, low padding (compact IDE look: p-2 to p-4, text-xs/text-sm font sizes, 1px subtle borders).
Never use raw transparent header backgrounds without backdrop blur or solid backgrounds.
Format NULL and BLOB table cells with distinct, readable badges.
Implement resizable panels (or smooth split flex layouts) with fallback to tabbed navigation on small screens.
Add keyboard shortcut binding (Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter) to trigger SQL query execution.
Ensure all interactive elements have valid data-testid attributes.
